notes: DeepFlux 9.2 - memory and CPU frugality: large downloads no longer buffer into RAM (a 9 GB ISO download used to hold 10 GB of memory - the HTTP layer now throttles at the socket and sheds runaway buffers, resuming without losing progress), the app idles at 6 background threads instead of 36 (IPTV pools now spin up only when the Play tab works), and the Commander's folder-size walks stop the moment you leave the tab instead of grinding the disk for minutes. Includes all 9.0/9.1 features and the AMD laptop stability fix.
